title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

title: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
summary: The agreement, which follows similar deals with MLB and NHL, establishes information-sharing to guard against insider trading as sports betting migrates to CFTC-regulated venues.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
summary: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

title: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’
summary: The Mumbai-based exchange says 15.99 million USDT was drained from wallets it retired after last year’s $44 million hack, bringing its combined losses to nearly $60 million—and it’s absorbing the hit.

title: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
summary: The iShares Brazil ETF fell as much as 26% after Lula da Silva beat Flávio Bolsonaro, who prediction markets had at 80%, while the dollar jumped as much as 12% against the real.

title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
summary: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.

title: Strategy Pauses Bitcoin Buying, Spends $205M Buying Back STRC
summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm's USD Cash balance fell to $242.4 million after its biggest weekly STRC buyback in more than a month.

title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80,000 Ahead of Fed Decision, Midterms
summary: Analysts point to a sell-off in AI stocks and ETF outflows, with HashKey's Tim Sun flagging $75,000 as the next key support level.

title: Bitcoin’s Bear Market Is Over, Galaxy Research Says: 'Now Is an Attractive Time to Buy'
summary: Galaxy Research says Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, pointing to a reclaimed 50-week moving average, fading selling pressure, and a strengthening debasement case.

title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Breaks Below $80,000 as Iran Fears Hit the Weekend
summary: Some relief is appearing this morning as oil and rates fall, with a big macro week ahead featuring major earnings, FOMC and key data drops.

title: Israel's Central Bank Rebukes Netanyahu Plan to Use Crypto to Dodge Sanctions
summary: Over 100 economists, including former governor Jacob Frenkel, warned of deeper isolation ahead of Israel's October 27 national election.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

title: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
summary: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
summary: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.

title: Senate Democrat Probes Tether Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser’s Firm
summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal demanded Tether’s records on payments to Nxum, a firm co-owned by former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines.

title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks
summary: The regulator's Division of Examinations named "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" as a focus area alongside tokenization risks.
